name: refined-whatsapp-web
description: Native-feeling layout, privacy, and shortcut controls for WhatsApp Web.

scripts.package: rm -rf dist/unpacked dist/refined-whatsapp-web-$npm_package_version.zip && mkdir -p dist/unpacked && cp -R manifest.json icons popup src dist/unpacked/ && find dist/unpacked -name '.DS_Store' -delete && cd dist/unpacked && zip -rX ../refined-whatsapp-web-$npm_package_version.zip .
